units.source_text: 过了一段时间，我又有了和夫人面对面说话的机会，那正是白天日渐缩短、寒意袭人的秋季。

en.t: After some time had passed, I had another chance to speak face to face with Sensei's wife; it was autumn, when the days were growing shorter and the cold was beginning to bite.

units.source_text: 近三四日来，先生家附近的人家接二连三地失窃，而且大都发生在天擦黑的时候。

en.t: Over the past three or four days, homes near Sensei's house had been burglarized one after another, mostly around dusk.

units.source_text: 虽然被盗的不是什么太贵重的东西，但是被贼光顾的人家总会被偷走点什么。

en.t: Although nothing especially valuable was stolen, every house the thief entered had something taken from it.

units.source_text: 夫人被此事搞得心神不宁。

en.t: Sensei's wife was unsettled and anxious because of it.

units.source_text: 可就在这个节骨眼上，先生有事，晚上要出门，

en.t: But just then, Sensei had an obligation and had to go out in the evening.

units.source_text: 因为先生有个在外地医院做事的同乡进京，

en.t: A man from Sensei's hometown who worked at a hospital in the provinces had come to Tokyo,

units.source_text: 先生要同另外两三个人在某处请这位老乡吃饭。

en.t: and Sensei, together with two or three others, was to treat this fellow townsman to dinner somewhere.

units.source_text: 先生跟我说明了原委，拜托我帮他看家，直到他回来。

en.t: Sensei explained the situation to me and asked me to watch the house for him until he returned.
